title: BLDG-2 — Model coloured exterior shell, core and six-floor structure
desc:
READ FIRST: https://github.com/dreamer2664/buildinglab/blob/main/briefs/BLENDER.md and https://github.com/dreamer2664/buildinglab/blob/main/README.md.
DELIVERABLE: A finished coloured exterior/structural shell in `scene/shell.blend`, built to BLDG-1 dimensions: six real floor plates, roof/parapet, windows/openings, façade depth, balconies/context as designed, a cutaway switch, continuous core, elevator, landings and two plausible stairs with handrails.
EVIDENCE: `blender --background scene/shell.blend --python tools/validate_shell.py` → exit 0 and `PASS`; report six plates, two continuous stair routes, elevator/core/landings, major openings and zero missing external files. Render/open an exterior and a full shell cutaway.
OWNS: `scene/shell.blend`, `assets/exterior/**`, `tools/validate_shell.py`
BRANCH: `agent/blender/t-20261016-0d4e`

PARENT: t-20261016-3fe5. Design dependency: t-20261016-c577. Keep every coloured façade material and real opening; a grey box or texture-only elevation is not a deliverable.
